The World’s First AI-Powered Digital Implant Workflow Platform

One platform. Complete implant workflow.

From diagnosis to definitive prosthesis, Implanr transforms implant treatment into a standardized, intelligent, and fully documented digital workflow. Every implant case, every approval, every document, every decision — connected in one platform.

Implanr AI

AI that understands implant dentistry.

Meet Implanr AI. Unlike general AI assistants, Implanr AI understands implant workflows, implant catalogues, institutional protocols, and your patient’s clinical data. Every response is grounded in:

  • Current patient information
  • CBCT measurements
  • Implant planning
  • Implant catalogue
  • Clinical workflow
  • Institutional protocols
  • Faculty comments
  • Approval history
  • Scientific recommendations

AI that reads your chart — not the internet.

  • “Which implant is safest for this ridge?”
  • “Why was Phase 2 rejected?”
  • “Compare Straumann BLT with Astra EV.”
  • “Generate surgical notes.”
  • “Explain the drilling protocol.”
  • “Summarize today’s surgery.”
  • “Show alternative implants.”
  • “Generate patient explanation.”
  • “Generate faculty summary.”

Smart Implant Selection

Evidence-driven. Not guesswork.

Selecting an implant should be evidence-driven — not guesswork. Implanr includes a comprehensive implant knowledge base with more than 70 implant systems from leading manufacturers. Browse by:

  • Implant company
  • Implant system
  • Diameter
  • Length
  • Platform
  • Connection type
  • Bone quality
  • Loading protocol
  • Indications
  • Prosthetic compatibility

AI can automatically suggest the safest implant options based on bone dimensions, procedure type, and restorative requirements.
